document.about: Kohler K-R33912 faucet spec sheet. Each page's head and foot rules are drawn far past the page and clipped to the text's width; page 2 sets two columns under its head rule.

notes: #290: a rule clipped to the stretch that shows was read as drawn, wider than the page, and dropped as page decoration; page 2's two columns then read band by band.

checks.issue: #290: `Recommended Products/Accessories` from the right column came between `CSA B651` and `Technical Information` in the left.
